label: Orange Pi 5 Plus SBC
description: Rockchip RK3588 SBC with two independent 2.5GbE ports (RTL8125 on PCIe) plus an M.2 E-key slot for an optional Wi-Fi 6 module - no radio is fitted on the board.
notes: Dual 2.5G: the cheapest way to get two 2.5G ports in a lab router/firewall role (VyOS/OpenWrt). No onboard Wi-Fi - add a 2230 Wi-Fi 6 module to the M.2 E-key slot and add wlan0 to the model if the lab needs it.
